info.title: Charsooq Admin API
info.summary: Catalog, pricing, and competitor administration for چهارسوق.
info.description:
Administrative API for **چهارسوق (Charsooq)** — a Persian, RTL-first catalog and pricing panel.

- **Base path**: `/api/v1`
- **Authentication**: `POST /api/v1/auth/login` sets an HttpOnly session cookie.
  Send it with every protected request (`credentials: "include"` in the browser).
- **Errors**: failures use one envelope, `{"error": {"code", "message", "details?"}}`.
  `message` and `details` are user-facing Persian text.
- **Machine values**: Toman amounts, UTC timestamps, ISO dates. The UI applies
  Persian digits, grouping, and the Jalali calendar at render time.

The committed contract is `backend/api/openapi.json`; CI fails when it is stale.

get.description: Returns `ok` while the process is running. It does not touch the database.
Runs `SELECT 1` and returns `ready` only when the database answers.
Effective OpenAI-compatible base URL, model id, shared system prompt, and whether an API key is stored. The key itself is never returned.

post.summary: Stream an AI analysis of one product
post.description: Builds a bounded, privacy-safe context for one product (the catalog row, fresh competitor prices, and the live 30-day cardex) and streams the model analysis as Server-Sent Events. The client sends no prompt and cannot inject context; counterparty names, invoice ids, and competitor URLs never leave the backend. Owner and admin only.
